findings.finding: On 2026-11-12 Nanox signed a Yorkville Standby Equity Purchase Agreement: up to $10.0M primary at 97% of the lowest daily VWAP over a three-day pricing period (registering ~31.4M advance shares at $0.318, ~40% of the 78.75M outstanding) plus a $40M resale SEPA and 1.22M commitment shares; the first 725,600 shares were sold to Yorkville on 2026-11-18 at $0.3132 for $227k, with shares outstanding at 80.39M. Asked what the money buys: survival under a going-concern flag, not a ramp (Q3 revenue flat q/q at $4.3-4.4M, no change in ARC deployments), so it signs negative, and the pricing formula rewards Yorkville for selling into any print-day rally.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The SEPA 6-K day (2026-11-12) the stock fell -12.64% (sealed baseline history) and it is -28.75% over the five sessions since the first advance; the August $8M registered direct at $1.00 preceded the slide from ~$1 to $0.40 by mid-October.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the 5-day -29% is consistent with Yorkville distribution. What is not priced is the print-day mechanic: any rally on the call gives Yorkville a fresh, higher VWAP to sell advances into, so upside is capped while the first-day reaction is open; if this were fully priced, the stock would have stabilised after the first tranche rather than sliding a further ~30% to $0.205.
findings.independence: 424B5 supplement no. 1 dated 2026-11-23 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1795251/000121390026122954/ea0313197-424b5_nanox.htm) confirms the first tranche and the 80,388,806 share count; Yorkville 13G 2026-11-13. Same issuer documents, different filings.

findings.finding: The adjourned special general meeting is at 07:00 ET on 2026-11-25, 90 minutes before the call, and votes on a reverse split framework of 1-for-20 to 1-for-50 and on raising authorized share capital by 200M to 350M shares (cut from +300M under the Moalem agreement); the 8.33% holder Moshe Moalem has contractually agreed to vote for both, so passage is likely and the result reaches the market inside the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reverse split or authorization vote at this company found; the meeting was originally set for 2026-11-18 and postponed a week, during which the stock fell from ~$0.31 to ~$0.21.
findings.why_not_priced: The vote is public, so the direction is largely priced; what is not is the confirmation of headroom: with 80M shares out and 150M authorized today, approval more than doubles what can be issued to Yorkville and others, which a $0.21 stock with a 1:20-1:50 split pending usually trades down on. If fully priced, there would be no further drift after the 18 Nov postponement, and there has been.
findings.independence: Revised proxy card (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795251/000121390026118528/ea031149901ex99-2.htm) and the original 2026-10-28 proxy (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001795251/000121390026113380/ea030999302ex99-1.htm); one filing set.

findings.finding: The board-approved plan of 2026-11-09 targets a 25-30% annualized cut in GAAP and non-GAAP opex versus 2026 (Q2 non-GAAP opex was $11.1M a quarter), a global workforce reduction and possible divestiture or discontinuation of Korea and other operations, fully implemented by end Q1 2027, with headcount, restructuring charges and dollar savings unquantified; the call is the first chance to quantify them and give a burn trajectory.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The plan's announcement was followed by +59.8% on 2026-11-10 on 108x normal volume, fully reversed after the SEPA; restructuring payments are flagged to raise near-term cash outflows.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline target is public and its spike was given back, so what remains unpriced is the quantification (a dollar burn figure or a signed divestiture). If the market believed in a smaller burn, the stock would not trade at ~0.65x September cash.

lessons_applied: Lesson 4 (financing is a question): asked what the SEPA money buys; answer is survival under going concern with no corroborated ramp (revenue flat q/q, no ARC deployment change), so the -2.0 financing finding stands.
Lesson 6 (finding inside what the company guided): revenue lands inside the 16 Oct pre-release, so the revenue-vs-stale-consensus finding went from -0.5 to -0.2.
